generalInstruction: Keep the team compact and aggressive in transition, while staying disciplined at the back.
attacking: Attack with fast transitions, overload the wide areas, and link play through the central midfield.
defending: Press as a unit, recover quickly, and protect the middle third to force turnovers.
passing: Play quick, vertical passes with smart switches and support to break lines.
structure: Modern 4-3-3 with fullbacks supporting attacks and a midfield trio controlling possession.
